item.text: I’ll build the pelican and bicycle as a ray-marched scene, with orbit and zoom controls for close inspection.

The scene will pair an ivory pelican with a teal bicycle, animated pedals, and webbed feet that stay on the pedals. Cursor-centered zoom and panning will make the beak, handlebars, and drivetrain easy to inspect.

The renderer API and controls pass mocked checks, including the right-side camera view and listener cleanup. I’m checking the proportions, pedal contacts, and shader structure next; a live WebGL preview isn’t available here.
